name: algorithmic-prompting
description: Partition work into broad parallel lanes and a small number of atomic commit-sized subtasks.

interface.shortDescription: Plan parallel worktrees and draft bounded agent prompts.
interface.longDescription: Partition implementation goals into broad parallel lanes, then split each lane into the fewest atomic commits needed for reviewable and revertible history; map every task one-to-one to a commit and coding-agent prompt; derive lane and commit DAGs; and advance work through human-approved Kahn scheduling.
capabilities: One structured commit per dispatched task
interface.defaultPrompt: Partition this goal into broad parallel lanes, split each lane into the fewest atomic commit-sized tasks, map every task one-to-one to an outcome-based commit without internal graph IDs, and guide manual Kahn execution.
